title: Winter Palace
blurb: Bartolomeo Rastrelli’s Elizabethan Baroque palace (1754-1762): a 215 m green-and-white facade on the Neva, home of the Romanovs and now the Hermitage Museum.

systems.name: Facades
systems.description: The green-and-white Baroque facades: rusticated ground floor, piano nobile, attic.

systems.name: Parapet sculpture
systems.description: Statues and vases lining the parapets.

systems.name: Courtyard
systems.description: The inner ceremonial courtyard with its three arches.

systems.name: State interiors
systems.description: The Jordan Staircase and state rooms.
